records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Freight revenues increased 4% in the second quarter of 2025 compared to the same period in 2024 driven by 4% volume increases and core pricing gains, partially offset by lower fuel surcharge revenues and unfavorable business mix (for example, relative increases in shipments with a lower ARC, such as coal and intermodal).

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company reported earnings of $3.15 per diluted share on net income of $1.9 billion and an operating ratio of 59.0% in the second quarter of 2025 compared to earnings of $2.74 per diluted share on net income of $1.7 billion and an operating ratio of 60.0% for the second quarter of 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating expenses increased slightly compared to the second quarter of 2024 due to volume-related costs, inflation, a $55 million crew staffing agreement ratification charge, and higher depreciation.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Compared to second quarter of last year, operating income increased 5% to $2.5 billion and operating ratio of 59.0% improved 1.0 point, reflecting top-line growth, solid operational performance, and productivity gains.
